## [1.0.0] — 2025-04-11

### Rilis Pertama

RTL IFUMMI 25 versi pertama — aplikasi desktop untuk ngoding ESP32 secara visual pakai IoT Trainer Kit IFUMMI.

---

### Yang Baru

#### Editor Visual
- Editor blok buat coding ESP32 tanpa nulis kode
- Blok sensor, aktuator, logika, loop, kondisi, dan komunikasi IoT
- Preview kode yang dihasilkan dari blok secara real-time
- Support penuh semua komponen IoT Trainer Kit IFUMMI

#### Lingkungan Arduino
- Arduino langsung ke-install otomatis pas pertama kali dibuka
- Setup Wizard yang nemenin kamu dari awal sampai siap pakai
- Install ESP32 core dengan tampilan progres yang jelas
- Compile dan upload sketch ke ESP32 lewat port COM
- Deteksi otomatis perangkat yang nyambung

#### Serial Monitor
- Pantau output serial ESP32 langsung di aplikasi
- Kirim data ke perangkat lewat antarmuka serial
- Deteksi otomatis port COM yang tersedia
- Disconnect otomatis kalau port dicabut

#### Manajemen Proyek
- Format file proyek eksklusif `.rtl25`
- Simpan proyek pakai dialog Save native Windows, bukan download browser
- Double-tap file `.rtl25` di File Explorer langsung buka aplikasi dan muat proyek
- Kalau aplikasi udah kebuka, double-tap file langsung load proyeknya ke window yang ada
- Muncul konfirmasi kalau workspace masih ada blok, biar nggak kehapus nggak sengaja

#### Pembaruan Otomatis
- Cek pembaruan otomatis tiap kali aplikasi dibuka
- Download dan install update langsung dari dalam aplikasi
- Proses install update nggak keganggu meski aplikasinya ditutup
- Ada tombol buat skip versi tertentu kalau belum mau update

#### Multi-Bahasa
- Tampilan tersedia penuh dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan English
- Semua dialog, notifikasi, dan pesan error support kedua bahasa

#### Installer
- Pilih bahasa pas awal install (Indonesia / English) — semua tulisan ngikutin bahasa yang dipilih
- Bebas pilih folder instalasi, termasuk drive D:, E:, dan lainnya
- Shortcut Start Menu otomatis kebuat
- Shortcut Desktop opsional
- Asosiasi file `.rtl25` otomatis ke aplikasi
- Terdaftar di Programs and Features
- Data aman saat reinstall — folder data nggak dihapus atau diubah waktu update aplikasi
- Ada uninstaller lengkap

---

### Perbaikan Bug

- Nyimpan proyek yang gede bikin aplikasi crash; udah diperbaiki.
- Double-tap file `.rtl25` pas aplikasi udah jalan nggak muat proyeknya; udah diperbaiki.
- Muat proyek setelah workspace direset gagal; diperbaiki dengan retry otomatis.
- Proses instalasi jalan lambat banget waktu reinstall dengan data yang udah ada; udah diperbaiki.
- Bahasa installer campur-campur antara Indonesia dan English; udah diperbaiki.
- Teks peringatan overwrite workspace tampil dalam bahasa Inggris padahal aplikasinya diset ke Indonesia; udah diperbaiki.

---

en:
## [1.0.0] — 2025-04-11

### Initial Release

First release of RTL IFUMMI 25 as a desktop application for visual ESP32 programming using the IFUMMI IoT Trainer Kit.

---

### Added

#### Visual Editor
- Block-based editor for code-free ESP32 programming
- Blocks for sensors, actuators, logic, loops, conditions, and IoT communication
- Real-time preview of generated code
- Full support for all IFUMMI IoT Trainer Kit components

#### Arduino Environment Management
- Automatic Arduino environment installation on first launch
- Step-by-step Setup Wizard
- ESP32 core installation with a progress indicator
- Compile and upload sketches to ESP32 via COM port
- Automatic detection of connected devices

#### Serial Monitor
- Real-time serial output monitoring from ESP32
- Send data to the device via the serial interface
- Automatic detection of available COM ports
- Auto-disconnect when the port is unplugged

#### Project Management
- Exclusive `.rtl25` project file format
- Save projects using the native Windows Save dialog instead of a browser download
- Double-clicking a `.rtl25` file in File Explorer opens the app and loads the project directly
- If the app is already running, double-clicking a file loads the project into the existing window
- Overwrite confirmation dialog when the current workspace contains blocks

#### Auto-Update
- Automatic update check on every application launch
- Download and install updates from within the application
- The update installation process is not interrupted when the app is closed
- Option to skip a specific version

#### Multi-Language Support
- Full UI available in English and Bahasa Indonesia
- All dialogs, error messages, notifications, and labels support both languages

#### Installer
- Language selection at the start of installation (English / Indonesian) — all text follows the selected language
- Custom installation directory, including drives D:, E:, and others
- Automatic Start Menu shortcut
- Optional Desktop shortcut
- Automatic `.rtl25` file association
- Registered in Programs and Features
- Data is preserved on reinstall — the data folder is never deleted or modified when updating
- Full uninstaller

---

### Pre-Release Bug Fixes

- Saving a large project caused the application to crash; fixed.
- Double-clicking a `.rtl25` file while the app was already running did not load the project; fixed.
- Loading a project after resetting the workspace failed; fixed with an automatic retry mechanism.
- The installation process ran very slowly during reinstall with existing data; fixed.
- Installer language was mixing Indonesian and English strings; fixed.
- The workspace overwrite warning was displayed in English even when the interface was set to Indonesian; fixed.

---
